name: Unit 8 - Galen System Focused Review - Hematology Student

slides.title: Hematology System
text: Erythrocytes (RBC) formed in bone marrow of flat bones, and proximal ends of femur and humerus
Erythropoietin: substance produced by kidney to stimulate bone marrow production of RBCs
Primary function to transport oxygen from lungs to tissue

slides.title: Hematology System
text: Need adequate intake of iron for RBC to mature- 120 days
B12 and folic acid is required for DNA synthesis
Iron storage sites: liver, spleen, bone marrow
95-98% of O2 is connected to hemoglobin and reflects our O2 reserve

slides.title: Anemia
text: Low RBC count and below normal Hgb or Hct level
-  Premature or excessive destruction of RBCs (hemolysis)
What are the normal lab values for RBC, Hemoglobin and Hematocrit?

slides.title: Diagnostic Test for Anemia
text: Usually aspirate from sternum or iliac crest
Done at bed side; anti-anxiety agent prn
Pressure applied to site, may ache few days

slides.title: Iron Deficiency Anemia
text: Cause:  Bleeding (most common), rapid growth and malabsorption
Diagnostic test:  bone marrow aspiration;  most definitive

slides.title: - Weakness, fatigue, general malaise
text: - Cheilosis; cracks in corner of mouth
- Crave ice, starch or dirt; pica
- Nails are brittle, ridged and concave

slides.title: Iron Supplements
text: Dietary sources; organ meats, beans, leafy greens, raisins, molasses
Vit. C enhances absorption of iron; antacids interfere
If liquid sip thru straw followed by oral hygiene

slides.title: Pernicious Anemia
text: Stomach wall atrophies, fails to secrete intrinsic factor; Vit. B12 absorption significantly impaired
If no B12 is absorbed, RBC production is diminished
- Smooth, sore, beefy red tongue (glossitis) & mild diarrhea
- Difficulty maintaining balance d/t spinal cord damage

slides.title: Pernicious Anemia
text: Provide for safety in home to overcome proprioception problems, gait and coordination issues
When sensation is altered, need to avoid excessive hot and cold
Bland, soft foods until mouth/tongue healed
Vit. B12 deficiency is similar but client does not have a sore tongue

slides.title: Folic Acid Deficiency Anemia
text: Interruption of DNA synthesis & normal RBC maturation
Caused by inadequate intake of folate; fruit, green vegetables, liver
Folic acid replacements  - 1 mg/day or w/dietary intake; not usually part of multivitamin, so must take separately in addition to multiple

slides.title: Hemolytic Anemia
text: Blood transfusions to keep hemoglobin at 10g/dL
Only cure is stem cell transplant
Develop by infancy or early childhood
What is the treatment for clients with sickle cell crisis?

slides.title: NGN NCLEX-RN Practice Question
text: The nurse is caring for a client who has severe anemia and requires a transfusion of packed red blood cells (PRBCs). Which of the following four actions should the nurse plan to take?
Prime the blood tubing with 0.9% sodium chloride.
Check the expiration date of the PRBCs with a second nurse.
